finding_key: packages/notes/src/view/list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts::upstream markdown-it `lheading` rule is copy-forked wholesale instead of reused/wrapped
evidence: list-empty-bullet-plugin.ts:68-150 is a near-verbatim copy of markdown-it 14.x `rules_block/lheading.mjs` (same indent guard, parentType swap, terminator loop, and the three token pushes with identical map arithmetic) plus a re-created `asciiTrim` at lines 17-22, differing only by the `isLoneDash` guard at lines 100-106; it is installed via `md.block.ruler.at('lheading', lheadingRule)` at line 168, so upstream is fully replaced and frozen with no test to detect drift on a markdown-it upgrade. The claim's factual description of the code is correct, and the contrast with the `getRuleFn` delegation used for `list` (lines 170-186) is accurate. Its one weak point is the assertion that delegation was easy: upstream `lheading` ignores `silent` and pushes tokens unconditionally, so a wrapper would have to run it and roll back `state.tokens`/`state.line` — awkward, though still possible. Impact is maintainability only, since the shipped behavior is exercised by preview.test.ts:151-196, so I rate it minor rather than a correctness bug.
